title: Using Nsclient results in duplicate profileswitch events in NS and in AAPS
symptom: Upon enabling nsclient, already present profileswitch events become duplicated and are uploaded to NS. Sometimes numerous copies form and impact functioning of the app. Only the profileswitches are affected, flooding NS and AAPS with useless information and making the app less responsive. The times are sometimes also varying so that affects any autotune calculations one might do.
fix: this should be resolved in AAPS dev and NS 14.2.6
evidence_quote: this should be resolved in AAPS dev and NS 14.2.6
